Ein Hoch auf Oceanice! All Hail Oceanice!

Intro plays*:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pf0KZnm-ums

People of Oceanice, as we pledged our loyalty to the party and the humankind of Oceanice, we proudly fight back against the invaders who have no place among the human race. Our troops have marched through the streets of Kingusk, pushing back many of the enemy forces.

The government has ordered the relocation of many furries to Westmore and the U.L.R., displacing over 5.3 million individuals. Oceanice will not allow these invaders to take away our human rights and our will to prevail. Our dear President, Urman Albrecht, has delivered a powerful speech to the people of Oceanice. Now, live news coverage brings you the words of our president.

[u][b]President Urman Albrecht[/b][/u]

"This is a defining moment for all humankind. Those who are willing to fight against these 'non-human' species are the ones who will save our species from these invaders. No furries, no elves, no creatures other than human beings belong in our society. Both Westmore and the U.L.R. claim to stand for these so-called 'civilized people.' But can they not see the truth? These beings are a threat to our identity, our homes, and our families.

They are the real enemy! We humans are the supreme species of all Erene. We do not bow to these uncivilized beings. We are Oceanice, and we will not stand for the presence of non-human species in our society. They will bow to us, the supreme humans of Erene.
Glory to humankind!"

Background filling with roars and cheers*

[u][b]Cuts back to News*[/b][/u]

What a powerful speech our president gave. Oceanice has seen improvement in humanity of our great pride, Oceanice. We stand against those who sympathize with these uncivil beings, and they are brutal to all humans. Let the banner of Oceanice rise to all hope for humankind. 
For one to humankind, For one species, and one nation!"[/i]
